name: labs/abduznik__instrumation
title: RIGOL DS1054Z oscilloscope
intro: RIGOL DS1054Z oscilloscope, adapted from abduznik/instrumation. It reads `identity`, `sample_rate`, `timebase_mode`, `timebase_offset` and 5 more; sets `acquire_type`, `timebase_scale`, `trigger_sweep`, `edge_trigger_source` and 6 more; runs `run`, `force_trigger` and `stop_acquisition`. `run`: start the acquisition (:RUN) and report the trigger status. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
